children: Standard BioTools agreed to sell its mass cytometry business to Element Biosystems for $5.5 million in cash, following a board-determined superior proposal backed by GMT Venture. Concurrently, Standard BioTools and Multiplex Bio mutually terminated their prior sale agreement; the company will pay a $1.5 million termination fee, with $1.0 million contributed by GMT Venture. The new deal has no financing condition due to GMT Venture’s equity commitment and remains subject to stockholder approval and the closing of Standard BioTools’ pending merger with Treeline Biosciences.
